title: Ryan Mountain Trail
map_label: A 3D walk up the Ryan Mountain Trail to the summit in Joshua Tree.

stops.title: Ryan Mountain Trailhead
stops.alt: The start of the Ryan Mountain trail in the desert, with yuccas and rock.
stops.text: The route starts on Park Boulevard in Joshua Tree National Park. The trail climbs steadily over open desert.

stops.title: Ryan Mountain Summit
stops.alt: The Ryan Mountain summit sign with the desert valley beyond.
stops.text: You have reached the summit of Ryan Mountain, about 5,460 feet up, with views over Joshua Tree.
